title: Take the boating knowledge practice quiz
summary: Take an online revision quiz to practice for the knowledge test required when applying for a general boat driving licence or upgrading to a personal watercraft (PWC) licence.
intro:
If you want to apply for a general boat driving licence, or upgrade to a personal watercraft (PWC) licence, you need to successfully complete a knowledge test in the respective area.

To help you practise for your test, you can take a revision quiz for either licence, online.

The questions in the quizzes are taken from the pool of questions used in the actual tests but consider each quiz as a guide only.
what_you_need: You must have studied the boating and/or PWC handbook/s.

how_to_steps.text: Choose which knowledge quiz you'd like to complete and follow the prompts on screen.
As you progress through the multiple choice questions you'll be shown whether you've answered correctly or incorrectly.

more_info.text: At the end of each quiz you have the option to review the relevant section/s of the boating or PWC handbooks that relate to any incorrect answers.

faqs.a: This quiz helps you practice for the knowledge test required to apply for a general boat driving licence or upgrade to a PWC licence.

faqs.q: Are the quiz questions the same as the actual test?
faqs.a: The questions are taken from the pool used in the actual tests, but you should consider each quiz only as a guide.

faqs.q: How do I take the quiz?
faqs.a: Select the 'Take the quiz' button, choose the knowledge quiz you want to complete, and follow the prompts on screen.
